# nestwork

nestwork is a git-native memory protocol for AI coding agents.

Use it to give Claude Code, Codex CLI, Gemini CLI, Kimi Code, OpenClaw, Hermes Agent, and other markdown-config agents persistent memory and shared context across sessions and machines.

- README.md
- AGENTS.md
- CLAUDE.md
